message.content: Run two identical inference sessions with the same prompt in parallel: warm the prefix cache in one session, park it, and then resume with an extended suffix to capture its output and internal KV state; in the other session, run a completely fresh "cold" inference on the full combined prompt without any cache pre-warming. Compare the resulting token logprobs, generated tokens, and the hexadecimal dump of the KV cache tensors between the two runs; a strict equality assertion on the bytes will immediately flag any discrepancy caused by precision loss, stale data, or incomplete priming during the restore process.
